digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler — rich-text codec subsystem (Cloud ADF + Data Center wiki)
propositions: Markdown source (headings, lists, code, emphasis) currently appears as literal text in Jira Cloud ADF paragraphs and DC wiki, requiring structured encoding that preserves semantic meaning across round-trips without echo loops.

Cloud requires bidirectional Markdown↔ADF conversion with 99.65% idempotent round-trip fidelity; DC requires one-way Markdown→wiki rendering with pandoc fallback, both behind a state-based echo-safety layer using per-binding baselines and change-gated hashing to prevent duplicate syncs.

Jira-authored rich constructs (panels, mentions, dates) must survive rebar-originated reconciliation passes via origin-gating in the outbound normalization path without data loss or forced re-encoding.
Three-way conflict detection using baseline/local/remote comparison with last-write-wins policy must flag concurrent edits rather than silently overwriting either side.
Comment sync requires append-only creation with persistent local-key→Jira-ID mappings, routed through the same rich-text codec as descriptions, with no edit or delete operations.

The DC path must handle subprocess timeouts, missing pandoc, and pathological input gracefully, falling back without content loss, with a configurable timeout (reconciler.dc_pandoc_timeout_s) and GPL/SBOM obligations recorded for the bundled binary.
